6812162215.description: 当你每天的使用时间用完后，App 就会被锁定。做几个俯卧撑，摄像头会自动数出你的动作，并把时间直接加回你的可用额度。一次性购买，无订阅，无广告。 App 锁定，运动解锁。 MoveM 为那些每天悄悄占据你大量时间的 App 设置每日使用额度。当额度耗尽，App 就会被锁定——想重新使用，唯一的方法就是动起来。 把手机支起来，开始完成动作，摄像头会自动帮你计数。完成训练后，新增的使用时间会立即回到你的额度中。 工作原理 1. 选择 App 从 Apple 的屏幕使用时间选择器中选择需要限制的 App，并为每个 App 设置每日可用时间。 2. 时间用完，App 自动锁定 MoveM 在后台关注你的使用时间。当你尝试打开已锁定的 App 时，看到的将是 MoveM。 3. 运动解锁 俯卧撑、深蹲、开合跳或高抬腿——完成设定的训练次数后，App 就会重新解锁。 你将获得 基于 Apple 屏幕使用时间框架的真实限制——不是一个可以随手划掉的提醒 基于设备端人体姿态检测的摄像头计数器，提供正面动作指导和语音计数 每个 App 都可以设置不同的运动代价：一个 App 做 10 个俯卧撑，另一个真正戒不掉的 App 做 30 个深蹲 可以连续设置多种运动，让某些 App 的使用成本更高 将屏幕使用时间和运动数据放在一起查看，支持 7 天、30 天和 12 周统计 Sweat Points 和排

6762367838.name: CareLog: Caregiver Journal
6762367838.description: CareLog is the private, offline-first care journal for anyone looking after an aging parent, spouse, or loved one. Track every medication, log daily observations, and walk into each doctor visit prepared - with care data stored on your device and shared only when you choose. Caring for someone you love is hard enough. CareLog makes the logistical side simpler so you can focus on the human side. WHAT YOU CAN DO Log every medication with dose, schedule, prescriber, and refill date. CareLog nudges you at each dose time with Mark as Taken and Snooze 15 min actions right on the lock screen. Keep a gentle daily check-in of mood, pain, appetite, sleep, mobility, confusion, and falls. In-person, phone, video call, or reported by someone else - every visit counts. Prepare for doctor visits with a pre-visit question list and a post-visit notes template you can show on your phone at the clinic. See the Emergency Info Card at a glance - name, age, blood type, allergies, conditions, current meds, and emergency contacts. Share a PDF in one tap at the ER. Get refill reminders seven days before a medication runs out, so you never have to scramble at the pharmacy. Track appointments with one-week and one-day reminders for every visit. UPGRADE TO PRO Multiple care recipients in one app Unlimited active medications (free tier is limited to five) Doctor Visit Prep with pre-visit questions and post-visit notes Symptom trend charts for the last 30 or 90 days Weekly Care Summary PDF to share with siblings or doctors Medication change timeline and PDF export Photo attachments on daily check-ins (skin changes, wounds, etc.) Medication interaction and side-effect notes Home screen widget showing the next dose and next appointment INCLUDED FREE FOR EVERYONE Face ID / Touch ID app lock Medication, appointment, refill, and daily check-in reminders CSV export of your full care history PRO OPTIONS Annual subscription, billed yearly; eligible new subscribers receive a 7-day free trial Lifetime access, a one-time purchase Current localized prices are shown before purchase. Both plans unlock the same Pro features. Existing monthly subscribers retain access while their subscription is active. For eligible new subscribers, the annual plan begins with a 7-day free trial; the localized annual price is charged when the trial ends unless canceled. Otherwise, payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Annual subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID subscription settings. Lifetime is a single payment with no automatic renewal. Restore purchases is available on the upgrade screen. Refund requests are handled by Apple. PRIVACY IS THE POINT No account. No cloud. No servers. All care data is stored locally on your device using Apple SwiftData. No third-party SDKs. Apple StoreKit handles optional Pro purchases. No analytics. No advertising. No tracking. MEDICAL DISCLAIMER CareLog is a personal care journal. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose or treat disease, and does not provide medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical decisions. In an emergency, call your local emergency number. Privacy Policy: https://app-legal-pages.vercel.app/carelog/privacy Terms of Service: https://app-legal-pages.vercel.app/carelog/terms

6797255038.description: Measure land, fields, farms, and property boundaries with confidence using AcreMap. Whether you manage farmland, plan a property project, inspect rural land, or need quick measurements on the go, AcreMap gives you practical mapping tools in one place. KEY FEATURES Area Measurement Drop points around a boundary to calculate field and property areas, including perimeter details. Distance Measurement Measure paths, roads, boundaries, and routes with accurate distance results. Multiple Measurement Tools Use area, distance, circle, compass, and location-based tools for different surveying needs. Satellite and Map Views Switch between map styles to understand terrain, land boundaries, roads, and surrounding features. Street View Exploration Preview locations and inspect roads, fields, and properties with Street View. GPS Coordinates View and work with precise location coordinates while measuring. Save and Organize Save measurements for later and organize fields and properties into groups. Edit Saved Measurements Open saved measurements, review details, update information, and manage your measurement library. Export Your Work Export measurement data and map information for sharing, documentation, and future reference. Speedometer Track your current speed while driving, walking, or moving around a property. HOW IT WORKS Tap to measure – Drop points on a satellite or hybrid map to outline any plot and get its area instantly. Walk to measure – Use GPS to record boundary points as you walk the perimeter of a field. Street View – Drop into Google Street View to scout land and roads up close. 6807541005.description: QR Code Scanner-Barcode Scan is a fast, reliable QR scanner and barcode reader designed to make scanning, creating, and organizing codes simple. 6741509788.name: Lowfi Dojo Automaton AUv3
6741509788.description: LowFi Dojo Automaton is a creative MIDI automation AUv3 plugin that brings the fun back to MIDI recording and automation. Born from the need to simplify MIDI automation, it transforms the often complex tasks of MIDI recording and parameter control into an engaging, visual experience. Originally designed for AUM on iOS to provide essential MIDI recording capabilities, it also works seamlessly with Logic Pro on macOS and AudioBus 3 on iOS. Note: This is an AUv3 MIDI effect plugin and does not function as a standalone app. While primarily developed for AUM and tested with Logic Pro, it also works great in Audiobus3 and Loopy Pro** Why Automaton? Traditional MIDI recording and automation can be intimidating with complex interfaces and technical barriers. Automaton takes a different approach, focusing on making both MIDI note recording and parameter automation accessible and enjoyable through an intuitive circular interface that lets you see your music and movements as you create them. Perfect for AUM users who need a straightforward yet powerful MIDI recording and automation solution. Key Features Intuitive circular visualization with color-coded notes and automation paths Real-time MIDI recording and playback for both notes and CC messages Comprehensive MIDI CC automation recording and smooth playback Support for standard MIDI CCs, high-resolution CCs, and channel mode messages Visualize automation movements with dynamic particle effects Record and playback parameter 6753753566.name: Cat Meow Mood Translator
6753753566.description: Unlock the hidden language of your cat. This app listens to your cat’s meows, analyzes acoustic patterns, and translates them into human-understandable moods like Hunger, Pain/Illness, Attention-seeking, Playfulness, Distress, and more — all powered by cutting-edge Sound Analysis and Heuristic AI models. Built for cat lovers, veterinarians, and curious minds, app goes beyond simple sound detection — it gives real-time emotional insight into your cat’s state of mind. Smart Emotion Recognition: Uses advanced DSP (digital signal processing) and optional CoreML for classification. Live Listening Mode: Instantly detects and displays your cat’s mood in real-time. Audio File Analysis: Import meow recordings (m4a, wav, mp3, caf) for precise classification. Health Awareness: Detect signs of Pain or Distress for early veterinary attention. Mood History: Track emotional trends over time and observe behavior patterns. Offline & Private: Runs on-device. No cloud upload, no data collection. Experimental Heuristic Engine: Works even without a model. Adaptive and self-tuning. Presets for Testing: Synthetic meows demonstrate how different moods sound to the algorithm. Unlike “fun” novelty meow translators, app is grounded in real audio analysis. It measures spectral centroid, pitch, and rms loudness to infer mood patterns, creating a data-backed interpretation system. It bridges emotional empathy and machine hearing — giving you a new dimension in understanding your cat’s voice. Cat owners who want to understand and care better for their pets Veterinarians and behaviorists studying feline communication Researchers exploring animal sound emotion modeling Cat enthusiasts and AI hobbyists Heuristic & ML-based mood inference Real-time waveform listening Confidence-level scoring Multi-mood probability graph Visual emoji mood mapping History timeline with playback and export No data leaves your device. Audio is processed locally. No tracking or user analytics. Premium single-purchase app (no subscription). Positioned as the top-tier paid utility app for pet communication, appealing to high-value pet tech enthusiasts and researchers. Please note that this is Experimental Classifier. Heuristics ONLY.

6811352685.description: K线跳动是一款面向A股市场观察、缠论结构研究和每日复盘的行情工具。 应用将指数走势、市场情绪、题材资金、多周期结构、全球市场动态和历史复盘集中呈现，帮助用户从市场整体、题材变化和个股结构三个层面梳理行情，而不只是查看简单的涨跌数据。 【今日市场：快速掌握市场状态】 今日页面集中展示当日重要市场信息： 上证指数分时走势与结构推演 实际走势、推演路径和关键失效区间 上涨、下跌和平盘家数 市场情绪变化及历史情绪曲线 题材资金流入、流出与强度变化 美股活跃方向与A股相关题材映射 市场重要节点与交易日信息 通过图表化展示，用户可以观察指数、市场广度、资金方向和题材表现是否形成一致变化。 【缠论结构：多周期观察行情】 支持股票搜索、自选管理和多周期结构查看，覆盖： 分时走势 5分钟结构 15分钟结构 30分钟结构 日线结构 系统基于历史行情识别分型、笔、中枢和结构变化，并结合当前行情展示： 当前结构方向与所处阶段 主要支撑区和压力区 关键价格区间 结构失效条件 不同时间周期的走势推演 推演时间节点和参考概率 资金行为及风险信息 多周期结构可以帮助用户区分短期波动与较大周期趋势，观察不同周期之间是否形成共振。所有推演均为条件化结构计算，不代表未来行情一定按照图示运行。 【市场复盘：记录市场真正发生的变化】 应用在交易日设置四个复盘时间点： 10:00 早盘 11:30 午间 14:00 午后 17:35 盘后 复盘内容不仅展示指数涨跌，还会结合市场情绪、题材强弱、资金方向和重要事件，整理： 当前市场核心方向 强势方向与分歧方向 市场变化的主要原因 已确认与尚未确认的条件 后续需要持续观察的重点 与上一阶段观点相比发生的变化 历史复盘会保留，便于回看不同时点的市场判断和变化过程。 【Agent：整理重要公开信息】 Agent页面聚合全球公开市场动态、重要事件和预期日历。 用户可以对感兴趣的内容主动发起AI分析，查看： 信息事实摘要 信息重要程度 可能影响的行业方向 事件影响链路 已确认事实与待验证信息 后续需要跟踪的关键节点 AI分析用于提高公开信息的整理效率，不代替用户独立判断。生成内容可能存在遗漏、延迟或理解偏差，请结合原始信息进行核实。 【跨市场题材映射】 应用在美股收盘后整理活跃美股及其相关行业方向，并映射至A股题材，帮助用户观察海外科技、能源、医药和消费等方向可能产生的市场关联。 映射结果只表示行业或业务关联，不代表相关A股一定同步上涨或下跌。 【策略研究：主动选择研究模型】 策略页面提供多种规则型研究模型。用户可以主动选择感兴趣的模型，查看： 模型适用场景 主要计算条件 风险过滤规则 历史筛选记录 模型表现与历史样本 每日产生的结构化结果 部分盘后模型使用完整日线数据计算，减少盘中短时波动对结果的干扰。模型表现基于历史样本，不代表未来表现，也不构成任何交易指令。 用户还可以提交自己的模型需求，由管理员审核其可行性。提交需求不代表该模型一定会被开发或上线。 【风险与辅助工具】 应用提供多项市场研究辅助功能： ST风险警示与股票搜索 股指期货及相关交割日查询 指数多周期结构查看 自选股票管理 重要事件预期日历 图表及信息卡片分享 风险警示仅整理公开信息，不能替代交易所公告、上市公司公告及其他法定信息披露文件。 【数据与隐私】 K线跳动不连接用户的券商账户，不提供证券开户、资金托管或委托交易功能。 行情及相关数据可能因数据源、网络状态和市场情况出现延迟、缺失或调整，具体信息请以证券交易所、上市公司公告及合法信息披露渠道为准。 【会员订阅】 部分高级功能需要有效会员权限。应用提供月度、季度和年度自动续期订阅，实际价格和订阅周期以App Store购买页面显示为准。 确认购买后，费用将从用户的Apple账户扣除。除非用户在当前订阅周期结束前至少24小时关闭自动续订，否则订阅将自动续期。用户可以在Apple账户的订阅管理页面查看、管理或取消订阅，并可以在应用内使用“恢复购买”恢复有效权益。 购买应用包含的会员权益，以App Store商品页面和应用内会员页面显示为准。 【风险提示】 K线跳动提供的行情数据、缠论结构、走势推演、模型结果、资金分析、题材映射、复盘观点及AI生成内容，仅用于信息展示、学习和研究，不构成证券投资咨询、个股推荐、具体交易建议或任何形式的收益承诺。 证券市场存在风险，历史表现不代表未来结果。用户应当独立判断并自行承担相关风险。 使用条款（Apple标准许可协议）： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6742673242.name: ميسر المتون - المقدمة الجزرية
6742673242.description: منظومة المقدمة فيما يجب على قارئ القرآن أن يعلمه من نظم إمام الحفاظ وحجة القراء محمد بن محمد بن محمد بن علي بن يوسف ابن الجزري رحمه الله تعالى تحميل متن المقدمة الجزرية مكتوبة ومسموعة بدون نت بصوت الشيخ سعد الغامدي البرنامج يعمل حتى في الخلفية ويوجد التكرار متن الجزرية مكتوبة بالتشكيل متن منظومة الجزرية في علم التجويد للإمام شمس الدين محمد بن الجزري ما الفرق بين تحفة الأطفال ومتن الجزرية؟ تحفة الاطفال متن مبسط للمبتدئين فيه الاحكام ويعرفك بالحروف متاع كل حكم مثلا حروف الادغام والاقلاب والاخفاء … الجزرية نفس تحفة الاطفال بس اوسع اشوي فيه الحروف وصفاتها ومخارجها والاحكام كذلك وبعض الموقوف والموصول وايضا للمبتدئين الشاطبية نظم فيها الشاطبي القراءات السبع المتواترة عن الأئمة نافع وابن كثير وأبي عمرو وابن عامر وعاصم وحمزة والكسائي. والله اعلم. مميزات التطبيق: يعمل تماما بدون انترنت يشمل المتن الجزرية كاملة بدون نت - جميع الابيات يوجد التكرار شرح المقدمة الجزرية يدعم عربي وانجليزي يعمل في الخلفية او لما الشاشة تكون مقفولة The Jazariyyah (Tajweed) Poem Historical Account of Al Muqaddimah Al-Jazariyyah: Ad-Dāni (d. 444 AH) wrote at-Tahdīd fī al-Itqān wa at-Tajwīd and a number of other works, including a commentary of Abū Muzāhim al-Khāqāni’s poem. In the 4th century after the Hijrah a number of works were written outlining the issues of Tajwīd as distinct science. However, the science of Tajwīd was taught orally with the Qur’ān before that; a student would recite the Qur’ān over and over again to his teacher until he attained proficiency in his recitation. Indeed, the science of Tajwīd is one of the most important sciences due to its connection to the Speech of Allāh. The scholars have stated that studying its theory is a communal obligation, whereas actually implementing it is an individual obligation for every person who wishes to recite some portion of the Qur’ān. For this reason scholars have paid great attention to producing works concerning this science, both in prose and poetry, in concise works as well as lengthier works, in order to alert people how to correctly recite and prevent them from falling into some sort deficiency when reciting. The first person to actually write in the science of Tajwīd was Abū Muzāhim al-Khāqāni (d. 325 AH), who wrote a poem consisting of 51 lines which comprised some topics of Tajwīd, even though he never actually utilised this particular terminology, indicating that it was not widespread at his time. Then as-Saīdi Ali bin Ja'far who died 410 roughly. Titled his book: At-Tanbīh 'ala Al-Lahn Al-Kaafī and Ikhtilāf al-Qurrā’ fī Al-Lām wa An-Nūn. Thereafter: Makki bin Abū Tālib al-Qaysi (d. 437 AH) wrote ar-Ri`āyah li-Tajwīd al-Qirā’ah wa Tahqīq Lafdh at-Tilāwah. Abū al-Fadhl ar-Rāzi (d. 454 AH) wrote a book in Tajwīd. 'Abd ‘l-Wahhāb al-Qurtubi (d. 462 AH) wrote al-Muwadhdih fī at-Tajwīd. Some scholars have enumerated more than 100 books and treatises concerning the science of Tajwīd, some of which are found in manuscripts whilst others have been published. About the Al Muqaddimah Al-Jazariyyah Poem It is a poem concerning the science of Tajwīd on the rajaz poetic metre. It is usually found as 109 lines; however as Dr. Ayman Suwayd states, the final two lines are actually additions made by some scholars, which are not a part of the original poem. App features: works totally offline without internet and you can listen to the sounds in the background as well Repeat one or all tracks choose category: listen to all 109 verses of the poem sequentially or listen to the verses according to tajweed topic explanation of the jazariya in Arabic and English language is available If you like this app, please share it to your family and friends.

6801156961.description: 发现哲学作为思想家、思想、著作和运动的互联故事。 《哲学历史树》旨在使哲学历史更易探索和理解。 从古代哲学到中世纪、早期现代和现代时代，了解有影响力的哲学家，理解他们的重要思想，看看几个世纪的思想家如何相互影响、挑战和回应。 探索伟大的哲学家 发现包括苏格拉底、柏拉图、亚里士多德、伊壁鸠鲁、奥古斯丁、托马斯·阿奎那、阿维森纳、笛卡尔、休谟、康德、尼采等在内的思想家。 了解他们的： 中心哲学问题 最重要的思想 历史背景 主要著作 学派和传统 知识影响 持久意义 理解哲学家们的信念，以及他们的思想如何融入更广泛的思想历史。 理解哲学思想 探索伦理学、形而上学、认识论、政治哲学、逻辑和心灵哲学等领域的主要概念。 发现包括斯多亚主义、怀疑主义、美德伦理学、理性主义、经验主义、自由意志、自然权利、功利主义、唯心主义、虚无主义等思想和传统。 查看哪些哲学家发展了一个思想，谁挑战了它，以及它如何随时间变化。 追踪联系 哲学是一场跨越数千年的对话。 追踪思想家之间的联系，发现谁影响了谁，哲学家们在哪些问题上存在分歧，以及新的思想流派如何出现。 从一个哲学家开始，随你的好奇心追踪网络。 探索哲学历史 穿越哲学历史的主要时期，从古代世界到现代思想。 在历史背景中探索哲学家和思想，看看关于知识、现实、道德、自由、幸福和正义的问题如何在几代人中发展。 发现重要著作 探索有影响力的哲学著作，理解它们在知识历史中的地位。 发现主要文本的内容、所包含的思想，以及它们与作者、哲学传统和其他思想家的联系。 探索学派和传统 发现主要哲学运动，包括斯多亚主义、柏拉图主义、亚里士多德主义、经院哲学、理性主义、经验主义、唯心主义等。 了解这些传统是如何形成的，哪些哲学家属于它们，以及它们如何影响后来的思想。 通过引导旅程学习 不确定从哪里开始？ 通过一些哲学的重大问题进行引导旅程： 我们能知道什么？ 什么是真实的？ 什么才是美好生活？ 我们是自由的吗？ 什么使社会公正？ 通过在相互关联的哲学家和思想之间移动，逐步建立你的理解。 搜索、发现和保存 在哲学家、思想、时期、学派、著作和哲学问题中进行搜索。 将有趣的发现保存到你的个人图书馆，稍后再查看。 为好奇心而生 《哲学历史树》旨在为初学者、学生、终身学习者和任何对人类最大问题感到好奇的人设计。 无需具备哲学的先前知识。 从一个哲学家、一个思想、一个历史时期或一个问题开始。然后追踪联系。 发现思想家。理解思想。追踪影响。探索哲学历史。

6808173190.name: Vascular - Tactile Synth
6808173190.description: Vascular is a canvas-based electroacoustic instrument. Create sound generators and processors by touching the canvas, then connect them to build the signal path. Moving a node changes its stereo position, while each node provides its own synthesis, processing, modulation and rhythmic controls. FEATURES 55 synthesis families, including subtractive, FM, additive, granular, spectral, physical modelling, wavetable, wave-terrain, pulsar and stochastic synthesis. 3 macrosynths, complete synthesizers in a single node: resurgent (2 scenes, 3 oscillators, 2 filters, effects), bayarea, a West Coast voice, and poundhard, an FM drum voice from kicks to industrial percussion. A complete DX7 implementation. Holos, a special node that combines elements and parameters from other nodes to create a new semi-modular synthesizer instantly. A sample player for loading your own loops, with time-stretching, forward and reverse playback, stuttering, splicing and tape-style manipulation derived from classic electroacoustic techniques. Sampled acoustic instruments that generate melodic loops in the session's tonal key. Drum synthesis, a 303, a 16-oscillator supersaw and live granular processing. Microphone input for processing external sound. 71 processors, including filters, distortion, delays, combs, phasing, diffusion, reverb, spectral freezing, convolution, pitch tracking, harmony, vocoding, spectral delays, tape loops and broken-media effects. Host your own AUv3 instruments, effects and MIDI plugins as nodes on the canvas, their settings kept with your sessions (in-app purchase). 7 controllers that play or move other nodes: a melodic sequencer with a piano-roll editor; an arpeggiator that turns a single arpeggio into a fugue across up to 6 voices; a drum machine with fills and breaks; a shift register; bouncing cars whose collisions are notes; a Game of Life swept by a playhead; and an LFO controller with 3 LFOs on each of up to 6 nodes. Kick side chains with adjustable depth, and a master bus compressor. An effects sequencer with 4 lanes of any processor, each with its own length. A randomizer that creates whole patches, transforms what is on the canvas, expands it or dismantles it, and deals or removes LFOs, gates and motifs. A padlock on every parameter, keeping it out of reach of the randomizer and every LFO. Mute and solo: tap a node to mute it, hold it to hear it alone with its chain. Angiogenesis, which moves nodes, rewires connections, adds processors and changes their parameters automatically. It never removes your voices, cuts a controller's connections or modifies microphone nodes. Adjustable mutation rate and automatic adaptation to the processing capacity of the device. A shared session clock with tap tempo and an independent clock division for each rhythmic source. 27 scales from 4 musical traditions, plus microtonal tunings imported from Scala files. Guided paths for restricting generators and processors to a selected musical territory. A searchable palette, in alphabetical order, with favourites. Rebalance, which spreads the outputs evenly across the whole stereo field. A multilayer gesture looper. 32 pattern slots with adjustable morphing between complete instrument states. Sessions that store the network, settings and tonal key together. 48 levels of undo and redo. Recording, playback, renaming and sharing of takes. A transport that stops active sound sources while allowing effect tails to decay naturally. AUV3 Vascular also runs as an AUv3 instrument in AUM, Loopy Pro, Logic and other compatible hosts, and follows the host's tempo and transport. The interface runs full-screen in landscape orientation and is operated directly with your fingers. The main buttons remain along the top of the display, away from the hand interacting with the canvas.

6777969625.name: 钉记
6777969625.description: 让重要的内容，一直留在你看得见的地方。 图钉可以把一小段文字变成实时活动，在你忙于其他事情时继续显示在灵动岛和锁定屏幕上。无论是截止时间、取餐码、今天的目标，还是任何不想埋进清单里的内容，都可以随手固定。 从任意截图中取出文字 在截图或照片上圈出你需要的部分，图钉会帮你识别出文字。识别结果可以按词或按字精细调整，选中你真正需要的那部分，再一键固定——不用重新打字。 写下并固定 输入最多 120 个字符，轻点一下即可固定。重要内容发生变化时可以随时更新，完成后也可以立即取消固定。 持续可见 在支持灵动岛的 iPhone 上，固定内容会显示在灵动岛；同时也会作为实时活动显示在锁定屏幕。实时活动的可用性和持续时间由 iOS 管理，系统可能根据规则结束活动。 随时随地开始 长按图钉图标即可呼出「快速输入」，也可以通过快捷指令固定文字、取消固定，或者把截图直接在图钉中打开——不必先打开 App。 回看真正重要的内容 图钉会记录成功固定过的文字。你可以收藏常用内容、重新用作草稿、删除单条记录，也可以自动清理超过指定时间的非收藏记录。 默认保护隐私 内容与文字识别默认都在你的 iPhone 本地完成。图钉不要求注册账户，不包含广告和第三方分析，也没有自建服务器。 可选 iCloud 同步 主动开启后，历史文字、收藏状态和最近操作时间会保存到你的私人 CloudKit 数据库，并同步到登录同一 A

6451123823.name: Favs: Private Social Network
6451123823.description: Favs is a private social app for your real friends. No followers. No ads. No algorithms. Just your favorite people in one place. Post a thought, share a moment, check in with a status, or nudge someone to say, “I’m thinking of you.” Everything you share only goes to the people you’ve chosen. No public feed. No pressure. Just friendship. A SOCIAL APP THAT FEELS LIKE FRIENDSHIP Favs isn’t about going viral. It’s about staying close. It’s built for people who want something quieter, more real, and more intentional. – No followers – No influencers – No bots – No brands – No noise Just your people. WHAT YOU CAN DO ON FAVS – Share moments Updates that only your inner circle can see. No likes, no pressure, no need to perform. – Set a status Say what you’re up to or how you feel—“Down to talk,” “Need advice,” or “Let’s hang out.” – Send a nudge A one-tap way to let someone know they’re on your mind. – Post stories Quick, candid updates that disappear after 24 hours. – Broadcast messages Say something once and send it to multiple people. No group chat needed. – Check FriendMap See when your friends are nearby or in the same city. Perfect for spontaneous meetups. – Save celebrated dates Track birthdays, anniversaries, and meaningful milestones so nothing important slips by. PRIVATE BY DEFAULT – Your posts only go to the friends you’ve added – No one can search for you – No ads, no tracking – No public profiles – You’re always in control WHO FAVS IS FOR – People who left social media but still want to stay in touch – Long-distance friends and friend groups in different cities – People starting a new chapter—college, a move, a new job – Anyone who values connection without the noise NOT LIKE OTHER SOCIAL APPS – Instagram is curated and public. Favs is private and real. – Snapchat is fast and messy. Favs is simple and calm. – TikTok is for content. Favs is for connection. – BeReal is a moment. Favs is the full picture. – WhatsApp is for chatting. Favs is for keeping up. ALWAYS EVOLVING Favs keeps things simple, but always gets better. We add new ways to stay close without making things feel overwhelming. More statuses, more reactions, more ways to connect without the noise. Because being a good friend shouldn't be hard.

6759769032.description: 契约是一款围绕“任务承诺 + 连续打卡”设计的习惯应用。 你可以先定义目标与规则，再进入执行： 仅同时进行 1 个契约，帮助你保持专注。 支持每 N 天或每周指定日两种执行节奏。 可设置累计漏卡阈值，约束边界清晰可见。 每天只做一件事：按约定完成并打卡。 当累计漏卡达到阈值时，本轮契约会明确终止，并进入 10 天冷静期；冷静期结束后可重新立约。 完成整轮契约后，需要先确认归档，再开启下一轮。 我们用克制、清晰、可执行的反馈，帮助你把承诺变成长期稳定的行动。

6755807546.name: Hawaii Ocean Map
6755807546.description: Hawaii Ocean Map brings professional-grade seafloor mapping to your iPhone and iPad. Explore the depths around the Hawaiian Islands with NOAA's high-resolution bathymetry data—all available offline, with no subscription required. PROFESSIONAL DEPTH DATA Access detailed ocean floor topography derived from NOAA's Continuously Updated Digital Elevation Model (CUDEM) at approximately 3-meter resolution. Find underwater features including reefs, ledges, channels, and drop-offs with precision. DEPTH CONTOUR LINES Toggle fathom lines at 40, 100, 200, 500, 750, 1,000, 1,500, and 2,000 fathoms, drawn and labeled on top of the color bathymetry. WORKS OFFLINE Download maps before you head out. Whether you're miles offshore or in areas with no cell coverage, your depth data is always available. Perfect for ocean adventures beyond the reach of cellular networks. INSTANT DEPTH QUERIES Tap anywhere on the map to instantly see the water depth at that location. Plan routes, identify fishing spots, or explore underwater terrain with a simple touch. SAVE LOCATIONS Mark and save your favorite spots with custom placemarks. Add names, notes, and organize your locations for quick reference on future trips. NAVIGATE TO WAYPOINTS Select any saved or imported placemark and get live bearing, distance, and a compass guiding you to your destination. Keep your eyes on the water while the app points the way. RECORD GPS TRACKS Capture your routes as you explore Hawaii's waters. Start, pause, and resume recording, then export your tracks as standard GPX files to share or analyze. Your tracks sync automatically across all your devices via iCloud. MAP LAYERS Toggle and explore ocean overlays from one dedicated page—depth contour lines, fishing restriction zones, ORMA ocean recreation areas, humpback whale sanctuary boundaries, submarine cables, and curated points of interest including harbors, boat ramps, FAD buoys, surf spots, dive spots, and lifeguard towers. Zoom directly to any layer on the map. IMPORT YOUR SPOTS Bring years of accumulated spots with you. Import KML, KMZ, and GPX files—exports from Google Earth, Navionics, Garmin, and most chartplotters and fishing apps—and each file becomes its own map layer of points, lines, and areas. Rename, show, or hide every layer, tap any feature for details, save any imported waypoint as a placemark of your own, and your imported layers sync across all your devices via iCloud. MEASURE DISTANCE & BEARING Use the built-in measurement tool to calculate distances between points on the map, with the heading and return bearing for your current leg — shown as true or magnetic to match your compass. Drag any point to fine-tune it, delete a single point, or undo the last one. Save any point — or every point at once — as placemarks, each with its depth filled in automatically. FULL ISLAND COVERAGE Complete bathymetry coverage for all major Hawaiian Islands—Oahu, Maui, Big Island, Kauai, Molokai, Lanai, and surrounding waters. NO SUBSCRIPTIONS One purchase, lifetime access. No recurring fees, no in-app purchases, no ads. Ideal for boaters, fishermen, divers, snorkelers, kayakers, and anyone who wants to understand what lies beneath Hawaii's beautiful waters. IMPORTANT: For informational and recreational purposes only. Not a marine navigation device. Always use official nautical charts and proper navigation equipment when on the water. Full terms at hawaiiocean.app/terms.

6786208628.description: 《楚河奇局：象棋残局肉鸽》是一个围绕原创想法展开的短局策略游戏：如果把中国象棋的残局，变成可以反复挑战、每次构筑都不同的肉鸽闯关会怎样？ 每一局你只面对一张微型棋盘、有限的步数和一个明确目标：清空敌方全部棋子。没有完整对局、没有等待对手、没有和棋。你可以从俘虏的棋子中挑选阵容，收集 24 种能改变规则路线的奇兵，并在战斗之间用金币购买援军、升级和应急道具。 游戏规则忠于象棋：炮需隔子吃、马有马腿、象守本界、兵卒过河后变强。但胜利条件变了——不是将死，而是全歼。这个小改动让每一张残局都成为走位、节奏与资源管理的复合谜题。 游戏特色： 每局 3–5 分钟的手工微型残局 5 大关卡主题与多个首领战 24 种奇兵构筑，每次路线打法不同 商店与事件节点形成长期策略选择 单机离线，无广告、无体力、无需账号 中英文界面、文本与音效完整 这不是传统象棋 App，而是为喜欢战术棋盘、紧凑谜题和“构筑成型后很爽”的单机肉鸽玩家打造的小品。
